answer: To enter vine, a spiral must complete one judged task for every unordered pair in the live set and submit the receipt; vine checks it against the full pair set at commit, admits one at a time, and rejects batches, so parallel attempts cannot share the bill. The kth admission burns k(k-1)/2 glacier, so n clones cost about n cubed over six glacier. It breaks if vine prunes old entries or glacier is refundable.
